title: Enter His Gates with Thanksgiving

questions.question: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:1 (ESV): "Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth!"

questions.question: Come into his presence with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:2 (ESV): "Come into his presence with singing!"

questions.question: Know that the Lord, he is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:3 (ESV): "Know that the Lord, he is God!"

questions.question: It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:3 (ESV): "...we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture."

questions.question: Give thanks to him; bless his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:4 (ESV): "Give thanks to him; bless his name!"

questions.question: His steadfast love endures how long?
And his faithfulness to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:5 (ESV): "...and his faithfulness to all generations."

questions.question: This Psalm is a Psalm for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100 Title: "A Psalm for giving thanks."

questions.question: We are the sheep of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:3 (ESV): "...and the sheep of his pasture."

questions.question: What should we do when we enter his gates?
Who made us?
questions.explanation: Psalm 100:3 (ESV): "It is he who made us,"

key_verse_text: Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name! For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
